import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('daily_cost_5.csv')
g = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'])['BilledCost']
# z-score within group
df['z'] = df.apply(lambda r: (r['BilledCost'] - g.mean().loc[r[('SubAccountName','ServiceName')]]) / g.std().loc[r[('SubAccountName','ServiceName')]], axis=1)
top = df.sort_values('z', ascending=False).head(10)
print(top[['ChargePeriodStart','SubAccountName','ServiceName','BilledCost','z']])

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('daily_cost_5.csv')
m = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'])['BilledCost'].transform('mean')
s = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'])['BilledCost'].transform('std')
df['z'] = (df['BilledCost'] - m) / s
top = df.sort_values('z', ascending=False).head(10)
print(top[['ChargePeriodStart','SubAccountName','ServiceName','BilledCost','z']])
